title: Мужской разговор с Нагиевым  (Man-to-Man Talk with Nagiyev)

segments.t: Max sits down with Nagiyev for a serious talk, expecting a clash. Instead, Nagiyev confides that Vika flatly refused to fly to Paris with him. Listen to the full conversation in Russian first, and then we will walk through every line together.
Я за Викторией Сергеевной поухаживать решил.
А она отказалась со мной лететь.
У меня такое же глупое выражение лица было.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'I wanted to talk with you.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'to talk' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Well wonderful, let us talk.' The meaning hinges on 'come on' working together with 'talk' in spoken Russian.
'Have a seat right here, please.' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'have a seat' and 'here' in a few short words.
Я за Викторией Сергеевной поухаживать решил.
'I decided to court Victoria Sergeyevna.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'to decide' without extra filler words.
'Yes, I already noticed that.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'noticed'. Dmitry Nagiyev answers right away.
'I noticed that you noticed.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'you'.
'I invited her to Paris.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'invited' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
А она отказалась со мной лететь.
'And she refused to fly with me.' Dmitry Nagiyev anchors the line on 'and', while 'fly' completes the thought. Max answers right away.
'Wait, how did she refuse?' In Russian, the idea of 'wait' flows naturally into 'refused' without extra filler words.
У меня такое же глупое выражение лица было.
'I had the exact same foolish expression on my face.' The meaning hinges on 'at' working together with 'was' in spoken Russian.
'She simply went and refused right away.' Nagiyev pairs 'simply' with 'refused' directly, since spoken Russian skips English filler words like 'the', 'a', and 'is'.
'And when exactly did she refuse?' Max brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'when' in a few short words.

'I offered, and she immediately refused.' The '-a' ending on the past-tense verb for 'refused' marks a female speaker or subject. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я за Викторией Сергеевной поухаживать решил.
А она отказалась со мной лететь.
У меня такое же глупое выражение лица было.
Max realizes that Vika lied to him earlier just to make him jealous, and he quickly sees a way to discourage Nagiyev. See you next time!
